video_title: Why Deron Williams is SICK of the Jalen Duren contract conversation 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren's potential contract situation with the Detroit Pistons
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Duren and his camp don't necessarily want to be in Detroit long-term because they do not feel valued.
quotes.quote: The Kings are reportedly offered maybe your boy, Lefty, Sabonis, or they might have enough money for Kevin Durant in the summer. Jalen Duren and his camp don't necessarily want to be in Detroit long-term because they do not feel valued. Apparently, they have Jalen Duren's name circled for the max contract if he takes the qualifying offer next year.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren's contract dilemma and the qualifying offer
quotes.excerpt: If you talk to the Kings and they say we are going to give you a max contract next year.
quotes.quote: If you talk to the Kings and they say we are going to give you a max contract next year, no matter what, you are getting a max contract. If you have a belief that the Kings will do that and give you your bread, are you taking the qualifying offer or are you taking what the Pistons give you?

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Financial analysis of Jalen Duren's contract options
quotes.excerpt: His money goes so four year 160, that's 40 million dollars a year. Take the four year 35.
quotes.quote: His money goes so four year 160, that's 40 million dollars a year. Take the four year 35, it's not worth the risk. The 35 million is not worth the risk.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren's future earning potential and talent
quotes.excerpt: You are going to make over 150 million dollars. Something a top percent, that is insane amount of money.
quotes.quote: Jalen Duren, you are one hell of a talent. You can play. You can help a basketball team. My nigga, you are going to make over 150 million dollars. Something a top percent, that is insane amount of money. By the time you are 22, by the time you are 26.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Tyson Chandler's career trajectory to Jalen Duren
quotes.excerpt: Tyson Chandler when he first got in the league was a fucking issue.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Jalen Duren, Tyson Chandler when he first got in the league was a fucking issue. Tyson Chandler could do a lot more than what he is looked at upon in the NBA. Am I wrong by saying that?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Well, Tyson didn't really get his flowers like that until late in his career. But he was surrounded by very good point guards.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren's role and development as a big man
quotes.excerpt: You are not a Joel Embiid, you are not a Jokic. There is no issue doing that.
quotes.quote: You are a great pick and roll big, you are going to get better, but you are not a guy that we just throw the ball to go get a bucket. You are not a Joel Embiid, you are not a Jokic. There is no issue doing that. Those are rare breeds. You are not that, though. You can be surrounded by Cade Cunningham for the next four to five years, that is only going to make you better.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Tax implications for Jalen Duren in different states
quotes.excerpt: Michigan charges a flat rate of 4.25% on all income. California if you are in his tax bracket.
quotes.quote: Michigan charges a flat rate of 4.25% on all income. California if you are in his tax bracket is 13.3, that's a 9% difference. That's a 16 million dollar difference of tax over the five year contract.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren's potential team options in California
quotes.excerpt: If you are going to go to Cali, you go to the Clippers or the fucking Lakers.
quotes.quote: If you are going to go to Cali, you go to the Clippers or the fucking Lakers, because Clippers going to give you some shit on the table. Okay, so you are going to make that bread back. And then with the Lakers, it's the fucking Lakers. You are not fucking doing it.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating the Charlotte Hornets' past draft decisions
quotes.excerpt: Mark Williams was the biggest mistake. But he cooked. No, but you don't draft Luka?
quotes.quote: Mark Williams was the biggest mistake. But he cooked. No, but you don't draft Luka? That's because supposedly Luka and his dad don't like each other. There is a whole report, I don't fucking know.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Advice for Jalen Duren regarding his contract
quotes.excerpt: If you don't sign this deal, you need to fire him. It's 35 million dollars a year.
quotes.quote: If you don't sign this deal, you need to fire him. It's 35 million dollars a year. It's great money, it's the money you deserve. If you trying to get the 40, okay, y'all negotiate whatever, but if you don't sign this fucking deal, this would be the worst mistake of your life.
